description: The RE-ENTRY path at app/cbl/COTRN00C.cbl:117-121, driven with the ENTER key over twelve records. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives as 1, so 'IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER' at :112 is FALSE and control reaches the two statements no first-entry case executes at all: RECEIVE-TRNLST-SCREEN at :118 and the EVALUATE EIBAID at :119. DFHENTER matches the FIRST of the five arms at :120, which is the ordering gate G30 asserts - ENTER, then DFHPF3 at :122, then DFHPF7 at :125, then DFHPF8 at :127, with WHEN OTHER last at :129. This is the REENTER half of gate G38: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COTRN0AO at :114 belongs to the enter path alone, so on re-entry the map area is the received one rather than a blanked one, and there is no field highlighting to gate because COTRN00C writes no attribute byte anywhere - it copies DFHBMSCA at :81 and never uses it, and it does not copy CSSETATY at all. All ten selection cells arrive as SPACES, so not one of the ten WHEN clauses at :149-178 is true and PROCESS-ENTER-KEY falls through to WHEN OTHER at :179-181, which moves SPACES into CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED; the guard at :183 is therefore FALSE, no XCTL is issued and no next program is named. TRNIDINI is SPACES too, so TRAN-ID takes LOW-VALUES at :207 and the browse starts at the beginning of the file - note that an ENTER ignores CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST and CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST entirely, which is precisely what separates it from PROCESS-PF7-KEY at :236-239 and PROCESS-PF8-KEY at :259-262, both of which anchor on them. The commarea arrives on page TWO, anchored exactly where case13's PF8 left it - page number 00000002, TRNID-FIRST record eleven, TRNID-LAST record ten, NEXT-PAGE-FLG N - so MOVE 0 TO CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM at :224 is observably a reset rather than a no-op: the page number goes two, then zero, then one through the COMPUTE at :306-307. PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD then paints page one. STARTBR returns DFHRESP(NORMAL) at :603 (gate G47). The guard at :285 is the abbreviated combined relation 'EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF7 AND DFHPF3', which reads as three negations joined by AND, and ENTER makes it FALSE - so the anchor READNEXT at :286 is SKIPPED and record one is not consumed. :290 blanks rows one to ten, :295 primes WS-IDX at one, and :301 steps it once per painted row until 'UNTIL WS-IDX >= 11' at :297 ends the loop with WS-IDX at eleven: TEN rows, which pins the page size as behaviour and not configuration (gate G39). Records eleven and twelve stay unpainted - the look-ahead READNEXT at :308 reads record eleven only to SET NEXT-PAGE-YES at :310 - so eleven reads in all, and ONE send, the one at :326, because the extra SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN at :116 sits on the first-entry branch and is not reached from here. POPULATE-TRAN-DATA writes its two cursor fields on the first and last rows only: CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST at :393 from row one and CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST at :439 from row ten. Despite the mandated Java name TransactionMenuController, COTRN00C LISTS transactions - ':5 Function : List Transactions from TRANSACT file' - and what this case asserts is a listing, never a menu. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL paragraphs, the CVTRA05Y byte layout, the COTRN00.CPY symbolic map, the COTRN00.bms field definitions and the CARDDEMO.CSD bindings; none of it was captured from a live COBOL run, which this environment cannot perform.
